drug.proposed_mechanism: humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody which binds to the extracellular domain of EGFR
drug.intended_biology: inhibition of EGFR-mediated cancer invasion, metastasis and proliferation

trials.indication: locally advanced squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
trials.target_population: first-line treatment of patients with locally advanced squamous NSCLC
trials.effect_size: HR 0.84 (95% CI 0.74-0.96), median OS 11.5 months vs 9.9 months (1.6 month improvement)
trials.target_engagement_evidence: EGFR protein expression evaluated in 982 patients (90%) using Dako EGFR pharmDx Kit
biomarker_changes: EGFR H-score >200 vs <200 showed no treatment interaction
5% of patients with EGFR null expression did not benefit (HR 1.86 for OS)
subgroup_findings: No OS benefit for patients older than 70 years
EGFR expression level (H-score >200 vs <200) was not predictive of efficacy
trials.dose_information: necitumumab 800 mg on days 1 and 8 of every 3-week cycle with gemcitabine 1250 mg/m2 and cisplatin 75 mg/m2
trials.outcome_summary: Modest but statistically significant improvement in OS (1.6 months) and PFS (0.2 months) with necitumumab addition to chemotherapy in squamous NSCLC, though with increased toxicity including fatal cardiopulmonary events.
trials.reviewer_commentary: Although the OS advantage is modest, OS is a direct and objective measure of clinical benefit, a composite of safety and efficacy, and some patients may be willing to incur an increased risk of toxicities such as rash and VTE in order to increase the likelihood of modestly improving survival.

trials.target_population: first-line treatment of patients with stage IV non-squamous NSCLC
trials.effect_size: HR not provided, no survival benefit observed
safety_signals: Sudden death and death of unknown cause 3.2% vs 1.3%
Higher incidence of thromboembolic events 17% vs 14%
Study terminated early for safety concerns
trials.dose_information: necitumumab 800 mg on days 1 and 8 of every 3-week cycle with pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 and cisplatin 75 mg/m2
trials.outcome_summary: Failed to meet primary endpoint of OS improvement, with no difference in PFS or ORR. Study was terminated early due to safety concerns including increased deaths and thromboembolic events in the necitumumab arm.
trials.reviewer_commentary: The lack of efficacy in the non-squamous NSCLC population did not deter from the findings in SQ NSCLC since these are different diseases. SQ NSCLC and NSQ NSCLC can be considered separate disease entities, with different underlying genomic characteristics, different prognosis, and different responses to therapy.
